clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm sends a message across the sea to Onu in Darkshore. The sealed dispatch carries news about Oracle Glade in Teldrassil.

Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm writes from the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. His sealed dispatch is addressed to Onu, the Ancient of Lore who dwells in the Grove of the Ancients. Reports have reached Fandral about the state of Oracle Glade in Teldrassil, and he sends a courier south of Auberdine with word for Onu. The journey crosses the waters to Darkshore, carrying a message from the heart of the new World Tree to Kalimdor’s older, shadowed mainland.
